# Save-format fixtures

`glacier-v13.msav` is an upstream v160.8 `.msav` generated by
`UpstreamCurrentSaveFixture` from the pinned Glacier map at Mindustry commit
`19a0f40d44514f4802a8b79770456e7e32e34da0`. It is used only for save-format
and decoder-parity tests. Mindustry assets and maps are GPLv3; see the upstream
repository for the original license and authors.

`glacier-v13-decoded.txt` is the output of `-Pprobe=save-decode` running the
pinned upstream `SaveIO` on that save. The native reader must reproduce its
per-building and aggregate hashes.
